facts.fact: The Mozambique Revenue Authority's FAQ says the NUIT taxpayer number should be used for all incomes, including customs, and is compulsory for imports of goods and business licensing.
The Autoridade Tributária's FAQ says the NUIT must be used for all taxes, including customs duties, and is required for imports and exports and for economic-activity licensing.

note: Article says an integrated tax-management system and an ID/NUIT/birth-registration interoperability platform are being built, but does not say a computerised taxpayer register or new taxpayer number is being built, or that NUIT is checked against the ID.
Tax law on the small-taxpayer regime; mentions NUIT on invoices only, no register status, customs sharing or ID link.
The post only says a bank system will be able to query the NUIT at the Tax Authority; no register in service is stated.
The NUIT is mentioned only as a number that broadened the taxpayer base; no computerised register is stated.

facts.fact: CEDSIF's portal page lists e-Tributação as including a taxpayer registration module (Registo de NUIT).

note: Only e-Tributacao named in references; nothing stated on the taxpayer register.
NUIT is required in e-SISTAFE transactions, but no computerised taxpayer register or sharing is described.
Document covers land administration only; states nothing on this register.

facts.fact: Per Daniel Bay, firms obtain the Tax Identification Number (NUIT) at the BAU one-stop business registration centre.

note: Document does not mention the tax register.
